name: Thor Electric
imageAlt: Thor Electric website shown on a desktop display
body: We partnered with Thor Electric, a trusted electrical contractor serving all of Orange County, CA, to create a clean, professional website that reflects their 15+ years of industry expertise and exceptional customer service. With a growing base of residential and commercial clients, Thor Electric needed a modern digital presence that would showcase their work, generate leads, and highlight the personal, responsive approach that sets them apart.

The new website features a streamlined layout, bold service categories, and a testimonial-driven design that builds trust from the first click. From LED conversions to large-scale commercial installations, users can now explore Thor’s full range of services with ease, and contact the team directly with just a tap or click. Mobile-optimized and built for speed, the site is a powerful tool for a company that prides itself on showing up, getting it done right, and exceeding expectations.
result: Traffic increased by 34% in the first 60 days.
